sections.value: BROUGHT PURSUANT TO ORDER {{order}} AND UNDER THE INHERENT JURISDICTION OF THIS HONOURABLE COURT

TAKE NOTICE that this honourable court shall be moved on the, {{date}} in the hour of 9 o'clock in the forenoon or so soon thereafter, as counsel to the ____ shall be heard praying the court for the following reliefs;
AND FOR SUCH FURTHER ORDER OR ORDERS as this honourable court may deem fit to make in the circumstances of this case
GROUNDS UPON WHICH THE APPLICATION IS BROUGHT
TAKE FURTHER NOTICE that counsel to the___ will be relying on the following grounds for this application. {{grounds}}.

value:
Use this information to enhance the draft:
The HEADING should be, in full capital letter and should be centralised.

The SUIT NO: ___, should be located at the right hand side

Party role should be directly opposite the name, that is at the right hand side. Default role is 'Applicant & Respondent', use when neccessary.

The orders sought can be so many. Hence it should begin with, 'AN ORDER..'.

Always complete this 'counsel to the ___'. it is always the Applicant. so it could be Claimant/Applicant, Defendant/Applicant, Applicant.

The Title of this template can be modified to something related to the instructions. eg MOTION EX PARTE FOR ..., etc

If no {{grounds}} is provided, remove the entire block, including the sectionTitle.

 
Use today's date, to fill the date section.
